title: Baseline Inbounds Chair-Screen Play
description: A baseline inbound uses a chair screen to free a shooter for a clean look, practising the timing and legal screening that make an inbound play actually work.

content.objective: Run a clean baseline inbound set using a legal chair screen to free a shooter.
content.setup: A screener and a shooter set up near the lane with the inbounder on the baseline.
instructions: The screener gets the chair fully set at the block before the shooter uses it.
The shooter pushes tight off the screen toward the corner.
The inbounder reads the defense and delivers the pass the moment the shooter is open.
Reset and run the same play again to build repetition and timing.
coachingPoints: Set the screen with the chair fully stationary before any contact.
The shooter should push tight to the screen, not wide around it.
Inbounder needs to be ready to deliver the pass quickly.
commonMistakes: Screening while the chair is still moving.
Shooter cutting wide and missing the benefit of the screen.
Rushing the set instead of trusting the timing of the play.
content.safety: Screens must be legal and stationary; defenders should avoid unnecessary contact fighting through.
